resources.string: Ask JotDrop: AI with your own key

Give JotDrop tasks in your own words, typed or spoken. It uses an AI service you choose, with your own key, and talks to it straight from this phone. JotDrop\'s servers never see your notes, your questions or your key. You pay the AI service yourself. \"This week\" sends a short digest of your notes, not the notes themselves.
Note: outside the EEA, Switzerland and the UK, Google may use what you send on Gemini\'s free tier to improve its products. On the paid tier it does not.
An https address that speaks the OpenAI API, such as Ollama or LM Studio behind https, or Mistral. Plain http is blocked on Android.
On Android, use an https address.

JotDrop compares your notes on this phone. Finding duplicates uses no AI and sends nothing. \"Merge with AI\" is a separate choice: it sends the two notes you pick to your AI service. Notes from shared groups and notes with a live list link are left out, and so are very short notes and the trash.
